meta.title: Maricopa County Office of Public Defense Services Billing Guidelines
meta.licence: No licence stated. Government/public-institution publication posted on the open web; used only as a public document for internal evaluation, not redistributed.
meta.pii_note: Public document from an agency or court; counts only, no matched text recorded. Hits: case_party_marker 1. Hits are agency contact details, addresses and generic role words, not private individuals.

params.unit: six months from date of service

rules.paraphrase: Demand for payment must be submitted within six months of the date of service.
No payment for dates on a current invoice that fall within the date range of an earlier processed invoice.
No double billing: the same time may not be billed on two cases, and similar same-day tasks need detail showing no repetition.
Time is reported in tenths of an hour; multiple tasks under 0.1 hour in one day are aggregated and only actual total time claimed.
Entries must describe the work and persons involved in enough detail; boilerplate documents bill only adaptation time; reconstructive timekeeping is prohibited.
Clerical work even by an attorney, non-substantive motions to continue, and in-county travel time are not compensable.
Office-operation costs, research plans, phone fees, seminars and in-town parking are not reimbursable.
Meals need prior overnight authorization and receipts; airline travel is requested 15 business days ahead within city-pair rates.
Fixed hourly pay rates for investigators, mitigation specialists, paralegals and parental social workers.
Experts and other providers need prior authorization and are not paid beyond authorized hours.
Document and media review entries state what was reviewed and its size; each entry names who did the work; tasks are in chronological order.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Invoices needing excessive audit time because of disorganisation are rejected.
Billable time is limited to work that substantially advances the case.
Billable court time begins at the scheduled start or arrival and ends at conclusion; no billing to prepare a covering attorney.
